items.content: 据《连线》查阅的内部通信，一位英伟达资深工程师在黄仁勋辞职前通过公司内网「建议箱」发帖，要求董事会先听取员工意见。报道发布时，帖子已有逾 1600 条评论，多数支持黄仁勋复职。还有员工向全公司发邮件，要求董事会解释他的离职经过。 英伟达此前已宣布由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时 CEO，董事哈维·琼斯出任董事会主席。董事会正从公司内外遴选正式 CEO。《连线》就员工的呼吁向英伟达和琼斯求证，报道刊发时尚未收到回应。 换帅消息公布前，有网友在 X 上建议马斯克聘用黄仁勋，马斯克回应「那将是我的荣幸」。13 日，他又转发了 a16z 发布的一段有关黄仁勋的对谈片段，只配了一个词「Jensen」。 美东时间 11 月 13 日，英伟达收报每股 162.85 美元，下跌 2.01%，盘中一度跌至 158.39 美元。公司市值约为 3.92 万亿美元，收盘时重新超越微软，位居美股第二，仅次于苹果的约 5.18 万亿美元。 问界新 M8 于 11 月 13 日在重庆赛力斯超级工厂上市。华为终端 BG 董事长余承东与赛力斯集团董事长张兴海同台出席。余承东说，华为主导的工作有赛力斯参与，赛力斯主导的工作也有华为参与。 据鞭牛士现场报道，余承东在会上介绍，华为负责新 M8 的核心技术、产品定义和设计，赛力斯负责工程落地、整车制造及销售服务。双方在 9 月签署了新的五年合作协议，问界仍在鸿蒙智行体系内，并组建专属团队运营。

Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock price fell sharply through the week, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding .

LangChain began in 2022 as a popular open source project that handled the kinds of tasks that early-stage LLMs found difficult, like searching the web, calling APIs, and interacting with databases. As the frontier AI labs delivered harnesses that now competently do those tasks, LangChain turned its focus toward managing AI agents. It has apparently found its stride in this highly competitive area with a simple message: letting businesses own their own intelligence. With its open source roots, the startup says its agent creation and management software, LangSmith, is not trying to lock users into any particular model, cloud, or ecosystem, unlike the major clouds or frontier AI labs. It also promises that LangSmith will contain agent behavior and is easy to use. True, there are plenty of other startups pitching similar advantages these days and also doing well ( case in point is newcomer Mintive ). The company was in talks to provide $250 billion in credit to OpenAI but ended up committing $105 billion . Huang resigned Thursday after reports of two extramarital affairs , including one with the company’s VP for healthcare, Kimberly Powell. The company is also investigating a possible Chinese espionage plot .

items.content: Democrats on Thursday opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China. Earlier on Thursday, the company ousted its CEO Jensen Huang . He also agreed to testify to a different set of Republican-led Congressional committees. Huang was removed from the company he founded after he confessed to an extramarital affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. (He has since been accused of having more affairs , with Nvidia employees.) The alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, was an executive of Nvidia customer Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that U.S. officials suspect of helping route advanced Nvidia chips into China. The Democratic inquiry comes from Rep. Richard Neal (D-Mass.), the top Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, and Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.), the top Democrat on the Senate Finance Committee. As the minority party, they can ask questions but can’t compel answers. President Trump agreed to sales of Nvidia’s H200 chips to China as long as the chips, manufactured by Taiwan, were first shipped to the United States.
